D/ [FL IVL HE]-LENAE AVG ; R/ [PAX PV]-BLICA

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena (AD 324-341), dating to the period AD 337-340 (Reece Period 17). PAX PV-BLICA reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Mint of Trier. Cf. RIC VIII, p. 143, no. 55 passim. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [FL IVL HE]-LENAE AVG.
